design_type: Descriptive prospective transfer experiment; fixed after the original half-year results were known and before new quarter-maturity prices, exponents or error budgets were computed.
question: Can the complete fixed-field residual-to-pricing certificate be instantiated at a different maturity with all output, exponent, strip, finite omitted-node and true infinite-tail terms recalculated?
probability_model: The original Appendix A model and martingale/affine-transform application hold for every finite horizon; use its restriction to [0,1/4], not a new market calibration.
reference: Restrict each identified frozen [0,1/2] field to [0,1/4]. The terminal quarter time is not an original knot: compute the exact rational interpolation of the original physical-time LG cell; retain full history from zero. Reuse the certified continuous residual and halfplane bounds on the larger interval.
new_fast_output: Execute the original unmodified GR [3/3] price implementation at T=1/4, composite Gauss-Legendre order8 to200 and D-type Jacobi order256. Freeze returned binary64 call prices as exact dyadic outputs.
new_pricing_certificate: Recompute quarter-time curve/power/hat moments, reference exponents, CF evaluation, coefficients, signed reference-minus-new-fast centre, strip bound, all omitted finite node bounds and true infinite tail. Never reuse the half-year numerical tail as a quarter-time bound.
true_CF_tail: Original direct-real-tail proof (14),(19)-(25) is for arbitrary finite T. Reevaluate its 64-time-partition positive q masses at T=1/4 for each alpha and all1025 nodes; separately reevaluate its uniform positive rate at V=128.
error_propagation: Use eta=min(delta_F*J0(1/4), old-state-uniform bound reevaluated with quarter-time mass); same-reference CF endpoint bound and independent true-envelope cap. No half-year numerical exponent error is substituted.
reporting: Publish all three candidates and every budget decision, same-centre signed marginal comparison and shared Fourier bound; distinguish reused upstream certificates, fresh new-output calculation and complete new aggregation costs.
independent_reader: Recalculate source identity, exact terminal interpolation, all coefficients/radii, complete centre/remainder and budget endpoints without importing the transfer aggregation implementation. Original rigorous elementary/moment primitives may be shared and disclosed.
optional_extra_node_phase: If separately generated complete alpha=.52 residuals on64<u<=128 of the same frozen field become available, an explicitly labeled supplementary full-reference result may be recomputed at T=1/4 with a new centre and full error account. Keep the all-three used64 transfer result intact.
scope_limits: Pricing transfer only, no new market quotes or calibration assertion.
No new true-model law, generic residual theorem, Padé formula or global originality claim.
No theorem for untested maturities inferred from three numerical results.
No external review score is presumed.
failure_policy: A valid complete interval may fail a budget; retain that result. Missing model, strip, tail, field identity, halfplane or continuous residual evidence prevents certification.
